# Aura

> Ambient gradient backgrounds, free and open source.

Aura is a small, growing catalog of hand-tuned ambient, mesh and nebula
gradient backgrounds built from layered CSS gradients combined with blend
modes and blur. Every gradient can be previewed, customized live (reorder
layers, tweak blur, opacity and blend modes, toggle grain) and exported as CSS
variables or standalone SVG/PNG. The project is open source and MIT licensed.

## Key Topics

- Ambient, mesh, nebula, prism, grain, glass, flux and lattice gradient backgrounds
- Layered CSS gradients with blend modes (screen, overlay, hard-light, soft-light, multiply, color-dodge, difference)
- Live editor: layer reordering, blur 0-100px, opacity, blend mode, grain overlay
- Exports: CSS gradient code, SVG, PNG download (1600x1000)
- Adaptive light/dark themes per gradient with manual override
- 207 gradients total, categorized by style

## Additional Resources

- [Homepage](https://auragradients.vercel.app/): browse and preview the full catalog
- [Full catalog (llms-full.txt)](https://auragradients.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): every gradient with metadata
- [GitHub source](https://github.com/CristianOlivera1/Aura): MIT licensed, open source
- [OG image](https://auragradients.vercel.app/images/metadata/og-image.png): 1200x630 social preview
